webhooks.detail: Per-request webhook object (url + optional events) for crawl, batch scrape, extract, agent, monitor events; 2xx within 10s, 3 retries

evidence.quote: Get notified the moment a crawl, batch scrape, extract, agent job, or monitor check starts, progresses, or finishes.

sandbox.detail: Free plan with 1,000 credits; also keyless free usage capped per IP/day for Search, Scrape, Parse

evidence.quote: Sign up for a free API key to get 1,000 credits and higher rate limits at no cost

rate_limits.summary: Per-minute per-team limits by plan plus concurrency caps; Free: /scrape 10, /map 10, /crawl 2, /search 10, /agent 2 per min; 2 concurrent browsers; 429 on exceed

evidence.quote: Rate limits cap how many requests your team can make per minute, while concurrency limits cap how many jobs can run in parallel.
Use an SDK to search, scrape, and interact with the web without managing raw HTTP requests.
